title: Synthetic Study One: Saline Nasal Rinse for Adult Colds
abstract: A synthetic randomized trial of saline nasal rinse in adults with a cold. Symptom scores fell more in the rinse group.

title: Synthetic Study Two: Saline Spray in Adults
abstract: A synthetic cohort of adults using a saline spray. Symptom scores were similar between groups.

title: Synthetic Study Three: Saline Rinse in Children
abstract: A synthetic trial of saline nasal rinse in children with a cold. Symptom scores fell in the rinse group.
